set.pl: About 3 mi WNW of Bronson village: sec. 5 T7S R8W, Bronson Twp (the village sits in secs 11-12). 1915 atlas: C. N. Phillips estate, 89 ac across the N part of sec 5, house at N end of the strip by the township-line road. The Battle Creek Enquirer's "2 mi east" is an error.

tw-mi-niles-andrew-jackson-gold.t: The 1904 Niles directory lists Andrew Jackson at 399 N. 8th St, just north of Ferry; he died in 1902, so the entry may be stale or a son.
